name: Debir
title: The King of Eglon
summary: Debir was the king of Eglon, one of the five Amorite kings who formed an alliance against Gibeon after the Gibeonites made a peace treaty with Joshua and Israel. He was defeated and killed by the Israelites during Joshua's conquest of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Alliance Against Gibeon
keyEvents.description: Debir, the king of Eglon, joined a coalition of five Amorite kings led by Adoni-Zedek, the king of Jerusalem, to attack Gibeon because the Gibeonites had made peace with Israel.

keyEvents.title: Israel's Victory at Gibeon
keyEvents.description: Joshua marched up from Gilgal with his entire army to defend Gibeon. The Lord threw the Amorites into confusion, and the Israelites inflicted a great defeat on them.

keyEvents.title: The Hailstorm from the Lord
keyEvents.description: During the flight of the Israelites, the Lord threw large hailstones down on the Amorites, and more died from the hailstones than from the swords of the Israelites.

keyEvents.title: The five kings hide in a cave at Makkedah
keyEvents.description: Debir and the other four kings fled and hid in a cave at Makkedah. Joshua ordered that large stones be rolled in front of the entrance to the cave to trap them inside.

keyEvents.title: The kings are executed
keyEvents.description: After the rest of the enemy had been defeated, Joshua had the five kings, including Debir of Eglon, brought forward. The commanders of Israel placed their feet on the kings' necks, and then the kings were killed and hung on five trees.
